title: approvals: when an approval step resolves to nobody (excludeSubmitter removes the only candidate), the request sits pending silently and the submitter is never told; the refusal text misleads a one-person organization
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · os-mickey · session_01ASNY8XiE8ZJYbrmzFDtS9g

**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible defect, reproduced on staging.

**Business reason.** In a one-person organization (the common Free-plan case) a submitted timesheet, expense report or travel request can never be decided. The submitter sees only "Submitted", nobody is notified, and nothing says what to do. If the owner tries to approve, the 403 says that another approver on the step decides it, but no other person exists. The maintainer's direction is that the org adds a member with the approving role (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2654), so the platform has to tell the submitter that.

**Reach.** objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2654 on staging `os-6hf1jq`, HotCRM 6.5.0. `timesheet_approval` paused at `approver_review` (`excludeSubmitter: true`, `onEmptyApprovers: admin_rescue`); `sys_approval_request` pending with `pending_approvers` empty. The owner's `POST …/approve` returns 403 "…cannot approve it. Another approver on the step decides it". Source: `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` ~5245–5265 and ~5727–5760.

**Expected:** when a step resolves to no eligible approver, the submitter learns it at submit time (or the request shows it): "No one can approve this yet; invite a colleague with role X". The refusal text names the same remedy when no other approver exists. The 2026-11-17 ruling (no self-approval, not even through the override) stays.

**Dedupe:** `approval no approvers resolved pending silently submitter` returned 25 hits. The nearest is #25635 (closed: the excludeSubmitter + auto_approve decision), which is a different question.

**Reader.** objectstack triage grades it and routes it to the owning lane. Not a claim; awaits triage. Filed on the maintainer's word in hotcrm seat 2's session (2026-11-19): 「平台缺口全部立卡」, after an independent fable-tier review of HotCRM's pending decisions surfaced it.
